records.claim: The time it takes the body to process or break down (metabolize) the medication is not the same for everyone. In healthy, non-pregnant adults, it takes up to 12 hours, on average, for most of the spironolactone to be gone from the body. The time it takes for the metabolites (break-down products) of spironolactone to be gone from the body can be up to 100 hours (about 4.5 days).
records.source_section: I am taking spironolactone, but I would like to stop taking it before getting pregnant. How long does the drug stay in my body?
